## Tools this post exists to feed

- [`hashtag-extractor`](/tools/hashtag-extractor) - Hashtag Extractor: Pull every hashtag off a post — from its link, or from the caption itself.
- [`youtube-tag-extractor`](/tools/youtube-tag-extractor) - YouTube Tag Extractor: See the tags on any public video, read from the page itself.
- [`hashtag-generator`](/tools/hashtag-generator) - Hashtag Generator: Balanced hashtag sets — mostly niche, where a small account can actually rank.

At least one `[[tool:slug]]` card goes in the body at the moment the reader needs
